source.title: Common FAQ – MIDI implementation / NRPNs
source.note: The source explicitly calls this table preliminary and says it contains mistakes. AIM Editor therefore keeps every imported mapping candidate until verified independently or against hardware.

alesis_quirks: For values that fit in 7 bits, community evidence says Alesis expects the Data Entry LSB (CC38), not only the MSB (CC6) used by many generic NRPN controllers.
Signed parameter values wrap in the 14-bit space: encoded = value for non-negative values, or 16384 + value for negative values.
Some addresses above the root range may be controller-assignment aliases; prefer root addresses where known.
Do not enable automatic live writes solely from this candidate table without hardware/capture verification.
